Totally get that – you want something that earns its keep, not a bargain that disappoints or a splurge that doesn’t feel worth it.

“Best bang for the buck” with our plants usually means:

Reliable performance in your climate (so it actually thrives long term)
Strong repeat blooming or long bloom season
Good disease resistance / lower maintenance
